usage: The word 健美 (gin6 mei5) is used as a noun to refer to the sport or practice of bodybuilding.
健美 focuses on muscle development and definition through exercise and diet.
It can be used to describe both the activity itself and competitions related to bodybuilding.
健美 is often combined with gym or fitness-related vocabulary when discussing workouts.
When used in a sentence, 健美 usually comes after verbs related to learning, practicing, or competing.
